title: Understand decimals
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show how you know. Writing the decimals with the same number of places, or a place-value chart, both count.

items.prompt: In 6.384, which digit is in the hundredths place?
Write <, = or > to make it true:  0.7 ☐ 0.68
Three sprinters ran 100 meters in 12.4, 12.09 and 12.35 seconds. Put the times in order from fastest (least) to slowest (greatest).
Maya says 0.45 > 0.5 because 45 > 5. Is she right? Explain.
items.answer: < (No: 0.5 = 0.50, and 50 hundredths is more than 45 hundredths, so 0.45 < 0.5)

items.prompt: In 25.617, which digit is in the tenths place?
Put these in order from least to greatest:  0.3, 0.29, 0.305
A bag of apples weighs 2.15 kg. A bag of oranges weighs 2.2 kg. Which bag is heavier? Show how you know.
A trip is 37.48 miles. Leo rounds it to the nearest whole mile and gets 38 miles. Is he right? Explain.
items.answer: 37 (No: the tenths digit is 4, so it rounds down to 37)
